summary: Content region inside violet-tabs, shown while the tab at the same position is active.

usage.text: Use it only as a direct child of violet-tabs; it has no attributes. It pairs with the tab at the same position, and violet-tabs toggles its hidden attribute. A panel with no matching tab stays hidden.
Inactive panels are hidden, not removed, so their content stays in the DOM and keeps its state while another tab is active.

a11y.text: violet-tabs names it by its tab with aria-labelledby and makes it a tab stop, so the tab's text should describe the panel's content.
